resources.string: OTLP export was disabled because the saved endpoint has an invalid port. Local monitoring remains available. Correct the endpoint and enable export when ready.
Assessment uses available resources only. Missing readings are not zero.
When disabled, pause and resume with the screen. The session timer keeps running.
Screen-off recording can increase battery use. Android or OEM restrictions may cause gaps.
Oldest readings are removed when either limit is reached.
Check values, thresholds, endpoint and the HTTP permission.
Stop monitoring and drain or disable the export queue before changing device identity.
Interval, collectors and thresholds apply to the next session. After saving, continuous mode, duration and screen-off behavior apply to the active session.

After saving, the mode and duration also apply to the current session. A time limit is always counted from the original session start, including screen-off pauses. Turning off continuous mode or shortening the duration stops collection immediately if that limit has already elapsed.

Leaving with Back or Home, or removing the app from recent apps, keeps collection running in the notification service. Use Stop here or in the notification. Process termination or a reboot ends the current session. The resume options can start a new continuous session after an earlier Start; Stop disables resumption. System Force-stop is not bypassed. Device restrictions may interrupt background collection.
Could not apply the session timing. Check diagnostics and retry; the timing change was not confirmed.

Optional · off by default. Sends collected measurements to a collector. Changing the endpoint or disabling OTLP clears the pending upload queue; local measurement history is retained. Delivery starts with new measurements.
Authentication: None. HTTPS verifies the server certificate.
Allow HTTP for a test lab

Off by default: only HTTPS is allowed. Enable for a trusted local lab without certificates. HTTP does not encrypt measurements or authenticate the sender. Example: http://192.168.1.10:4318/v1/metrics — use the computer address reachable from the phone. Turning this off for an HTTP endpoint also disables OTLP and clears pending uploads. Every retry checks this permission; HTTPS never falls back to HTTP.
MVP command authentication is absent. When enabled, other local apps can send commands. Real enrollment compatibility requires device testing.
Three comma-separated values: Warning, Degraded, Critical.
Structured stdout/stderr + Android Logcat. Verbose expires automatically. Sensitive payloads are never logged.
Open AHWOTel and start a session manually
Command rejected: invalid parameters or unavailable service
Monitoring stopped: storage or collection failure
Tap a chart for time and min / average / max. Gaps mean missing readings.
Old readings removed by retention policy
Allow notifications to keep the monitoring status and stop action visible.
With CPU collection enabled, also measure the probe thread. These signals do not change Performance state.
Time the agent probe thread waited for CPU during the measured interval. This is not system CPU utilization.
Delay against the planned probe time. Scheduling, GC and Android restrictions may contribute.
Availability check failed. See diagnostic log.
Checked inside this app. While idle, the short check saves no readings. During a session, it requests a recheck by the active collectors.

Continuous means no time limit. Start monitoring once to allow resumption; these switches alone do not start collection. A resumed session has a new ID. Stop in the app, notification or SOTI disables resumption until the next Start. Timed sessions and administratively disabled monitoring do not resume. Boot resumption requires unlocking the device. Android or manufacturer restrictions may require opening the app manually; system Force stop is not bypassed. With either switch enabled, Android may also restore a service whose process was killed.
A continuous session may resume according to the enabled options.
Resumption is not armed. Press Start to begin a continuous session.
Waiting for the service to start.
Stopped explicitly; automatic resumption is disabled until Start.
Resumption for this event is disabled in Settings.
Timed sessions do not resume automatically.
Could not start collection. Open the app and press Start; check Android background restrictions and storage.

Automatic resumption is blocked in this process, but the block could not be saved. If you requested Stop, collection is stopped now; the block after a restart is not confirmed. Restore storage access and press Start then Stop again.
The resumption state could not be updated in the database. Collection stops when requested; automatic resumption remains blocked by the saved safeguard. See the diagnostic log.
Automatic resumption is blocked after an update or an incomplete change. Start a new continuous session explicitly to enable it again.
